title: Environmental Nucleic Acid Extraction from Filter Samples Using MagMAX Kit
author: Yoko Makabe-Kobayashi
materials: MagMAX Microbiome Ultra Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit
For DNA sample: Phenol-chloroform extraction (PCI purification) is performed after RNase treatment. For RNA sample: TURBO DNA- free ‱ Kit (Invitrogen, AM1907) is performed.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Membrane
steps.instruction: Extract the filter membrane from the Sterivex cartridge and transfer it to a 5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Push out the RNAlater from the Sterivex cartridge using a 10 mL syringe (TERUMO, SS-10SZ).
Open the Sterivex cartridge with a tube cutter.
Using a surgical scalpel (Akiyama MEDICAL MFG, Replacement blade No. 15) and two sets of sterile forceps, pick up the filter membrane at opposite edges.
Transfer the filter into a 5 mL tube (TOMY, TM-657S) with the top side inward.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using beads and Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add the kit-provided homogenization beads into the 5 mL tube.
Add 800 µL of Lysis Buffer to the 5 mL tubes.
Place tubes in a Microsmash Beads Beater (TOMY, MS-100) and shake at 3,800 rpm for 1 minute, rest for 30 seconds, then shake again at 3,800 rpm for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and recover the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 5 mL tubes at 5000×g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 mL Tube (VIOLAMO MicroTube 1-1600-04), pushing the pipette tip through the beads to the bottom to maximize recovery, ensuring beads are not transferred.
Optional: Bead tubes can be stored at 4°C overnight after lysis.

steps.title: Bind Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Bind the nucleic acids to the magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Invert the Binding Bead Mix to mix, then slowly pipet 520 µL into each tube (do not use a repeat pipet due to high viscosity).
If needed, centrifuge the tube at 800 rpm for 1 minute to collect liquid at the bottom.
Shake the tube at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature using a Digital VORTEX-GENIE 2 (Scientific Industries, Inc, SI-A236) with appropriate support and platform head.
Place the tube on a DynaMag™-2 Magnet (Invitrogen™, 12321D) for at least 5 minutes at room temperature until all beads have collected.
While keeping the tube on the magnet, carefully open the lid and discard the supernatant, ensuring all contaminating homogenization beads are removed without disturbing the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to purify the bound nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Add 1 mL of Wash Buffer, shake at 800 rpm for 30 seconds (Digital VORTEX-GENIE 2), place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes, and discard the supernatant.
Wash 2: Repeat the wash process using 1 mL of 80% Ethanol instead of Wash Buffer (shake 30s, magnet 3min, discard supernatant).
Wash 3: Repeat the wash process using 1 mL of Wash Buffer (shake 30s, magnet 3min, discard supernatant).
Wash 4: Repeat the wash process using 1 mL of 80% Ethanol (shake 30s, magnet 3min, discard supernatant).

steps.title: Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Leave the tube cap open and let the beads dry for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Release the purified nucleic acids from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Elution Solution to each tube.
Incubate on a heat-block at 75°C for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on a shaker (Digital VORTEX-GENIE 2) at 800 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 3 minutes until all beads are collected.
While keeping the tube on the magnet, carefully open the lid and transfer the eluates to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the purified nucleic acid according to required duration.

substeps.instruction: Use immediately, or store at −20°C for up to 6 months, or −80°C for longer than 6 months.
